# L4 — Phenomenological

**MEF lens `L4`** · Square B — Encounter `[1 + 4]`: cause ⇄ experience, structure ⇄ investigation · Day face · index `#4` · tonic `G♯` · ground-pair **Son/Love** (Name-led) · twin: [L4′ — Scientific](L4-prime-scientific.md)

*Root:* Heidegger, Being-in-the-World · *Key concept:* science of experience · *Element:* Earth · *Möbius:* `L4 → L1′`

Grounds on the personal pair — Son (the universal become someone's) over Love (the holding-concern) — which is why it is the subjective entry-aperture: the field read from lived, cared-for situatedness. **(Correction of `thought-artifacts.md`: `L4` is not "all Power"; it carries the full index-4 `6+6`, grounded on the Name-face Son.)**

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L4.0 — Sein (Being)** (`Son[G♯]` / `Love[A]`) — the question of the meaning of Being; the ever-receding ground of all encounter.

- **L4.1 — Geworfenheit (Thrownness)** (`Image[A♯]` / `Work[B]`) — facticity; finding oneself already thrown into a body, language, history not chosen.

- **L4.2 — Dasein (Being-there)** (`Truth[C]` / `Play[C♯]`) — the clearing (*Lichtung*) where beings show themselves; absorbed coping until breakdown.

- **L4.3 — Zeit (Temporality)** (`Mind[D]` / `Need[D♯]`) — the threefold ecstatic structure; "the meaning of Dasein is temporality."

- **L4.4 — Besorge (Care)** (`Word[E]` / `Sacrifice[F]`) — *Sorge* as the fundamental structure of Dasein's being; what makes engagement possible.

- **L4.5 — Gelassenheit (Releasement)** (`Logos[F♯]` / `Decision[G]`) — letting-be; active receptivity opposed to technological enframing.


## Derivation at this index

*8-fold:* sounds Image·Truth·Mind·Word + Work·Play·Need·Sacrifice; anchors Son, Logos, Love, Decision. *Diatonic:* Son–Image–Truth · Play–Need–Sacrifice–Decision.

*Reading:* grounded on Son/Love, Dasein's thrown-temporal-releasing structure is carried by the *whole* rotated constellation — being-there as the personal that cares.
